title: Error
description: A structured error response. `code` is a stable, machine-readable identifier that clients MAY branch on; `message` is a human-readable explanation and MUST NOT be relied upon for logic. `details` carries optional structured context.

code.description: A stable, machine-readable error code (e.g. RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_PARAMETER, PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE, IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED).

message.description: A human-readable description of the error. Not intended for programmatic branching.

details.description: Optional structured context (offending field, profile id, temporal coordinate, ...).
